The team was led by first-year head coach [[Mark Turgeon]], previously head coach of the [[Texas A&M University|Texas A&M]] [[Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball|Aggies]]. In March 2011, Turgeon was hired to replace [[Gary Williams]], who retired from the position after 22 years at his alma mater.[https://www.baltimoresun.com/2011/05/10/maryland-hires-texas-am-coach-mark-turgeon/ Maryland hires Texas A&M coach Mark Turgeon], ''The Baltimore Sun'', May 10, 2011.
